description: This file contains an asynchronous function `enterprise_custom_auth` that performs custom authentication logic based on request parameters, configuration settings, and exception handling within a FastAPI-based application. It interfaces with other modules such as `litellm_enterprise.proxy.proxy_server` and uses external classes and exceptions.
